name: Discord
title: Discord: Rouh's own bot, you write to it and Rouh answers there

permissions: reads the direct messages Rouh's Discord bot has with the owner, and with each trusted contact the owner linked to a Discord account, over Discord's REST API every few seconds; nobody else's messages are ever fetched
posts the answer to the owner's own message back in that direct message, as the bot
a linked trusted contact's message is a case like their email, answered through the one outbox
jobs: the Discord reader (rouh/discord_chat.py Listener), started with Rouh
touches.remove: rouh/discord_chat.py, the discord service in rouh/service_keys.py, its section in rouh/templates/rouh/index.html and this manifest; while Signal and WhatsApp stay, rouh/chat_apps.py, chatappspage.* and rouh/web/chat_apps.py stay too.
